preconditions.description: Must be the contract owner to call setShares() function
totalDistributionShares must be set to zero via setShares(0, 0)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setShares(0, 0) to set both marketingShare and burnShare to zero, making totalDistributionShares = 0. This will cause division by zero in swapAndLiquify() at line 540 (tAmount.mul(burnShare).div(totalDistributionShares)), potentially blocking fee distribution functionality and causing transaction failures when swapAndLiquify is triggered.
